method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Bankruptcy Act 1966, Compilation No. 97, compilation date 21 May 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 47, 2026), Federal Register of Legislation register id C2026C00215; with the Bankruptcy Regulations 2021, Compilation No. 5, compilation date 1 July 2026 (includes amendments F2026L00133), register id F2026C00537 (ss 10A, 36, 82, 83); the ss 139S, 185C(4)(e) and 185M(1E) formulas from ../../registers/source-bundle/C1966A00033.formulas.md (transcribed by hand 21 October 2026 from the Word rendering of the same compilation)

checks.command: l4 run bda-cases-bankruptcy.l4 ; l4 run bda-cases-debt-agreements.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the debtor's seat. Part IX debt agreements: ss 185 (applicable deadline, frozen debt, provable debt), 185C(1), (2)(d)-(e), (2AA)-(2AC), (2E), (4), (4A), (4C), (5); 185E(2), (2AA), (2AB), (3); 185EC; 185F; 185G(b); 185H; 185I; 185K; 185LB(3); 185LC(3); 185M(1D)-(1DB), (1E); 185N(1)-(2); 185NA; 185QA; 185R; with ss 5(2)-(3) (insolvent), 40(1)(g), (ha)-(hd), 44(1) and 5(1) statutory minimum (Regs s 10A), and Regs ss 82, 83 (removal from the Index). Bankruptcy as the alternative: ss 149, 149A (duration), 153 (release), 139K, 139P, 139S (income contribution liability and amount; Regs s 36 dependant income). Not encoded: the Minister's s 185C(4B) figures and indexed thresholds (inputs), variation and termination voting, Court termination and voiding, administrators' duties, Part X.
lives: jake k065 (2037-04-20): a creditor's petition threatened; a debt agreement proposal instead, accepted by a majority of creditors in value
jake k066 (2037-06-01): a five-year plan, $690 a month to the administrator
jake k075 (2042-05-31): the debt agreement completes
